rollback.trigger: operator rollback, VIT safety/integrity incident, budget breach requiring stop, unexplained main movement, tree mismatch, duplicate effective integration, receipt loss or authority discrepancy

recommended_rationale: Q0-Q5 are complete with PASS evidence, the Q4 operational budget is measured/frozen, the proposed class is the already-authorised LOW_RISK_IMPLEMENTATION allowlist, the existing SIQ serialized gateway remains the physical write primitive, VIT writer authority is currently correctly denied, no unresolved safety-class/S3/S4 finding is present, and rollback returns to the already-authorised ORCH/SIQ path without history rewrite.
exact_work_after_approval: Materialise the operator DSAI3V-G-VIT-PILOT PASS decision and exact pilot authority record; no authority is active before that record exists.
Activate DSAI_VIT_PHYSICAL_CONTROLLER only for LOW_RISK_IMPLEMENTATION under EXACT_ALLOWLIST_ONLY while retaining DSAI_SIQ_EXISTING_SERIALIZED_GATEWAY as the sole serialized physical gateway.
Advance programme state to DSAI3V-WP10 / Q6 and run multiple low-risk lanes under the frozen VITOperationalBudget.
Require VIT prospective ordering; submit only the current qualified VIT head to SIQ; preserve parallel_physical_merge=false and all owner-programme authority gates.

For every materialisation require current authority, GRT/integration-sensitive assurance, exact physical/VIT tree equality and complete end-to-end receipts; capture all incidents and operator intervention metrics.

If Q6/G10 evidence passes with no new authority delta, auto-close G10, prepare DSAI3V-G-VIT-GENERAL operator packet and STOP. If a safety/authority/integrity failure occurs, forward-disable VIT pilot routing and fall back to the prior lawful ORCH/SIQ path.
